title: Area-code shard C pass 31 — 812 / 815 / 818

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public organizational actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 812, 815, and 818?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public organizational-role enumeration, seed-family expansion, and explicit uncertainty handling. X and Reddit discovery did not depend on official APIs.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, membership, public role, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For locality-derived NPA hits, geographic association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Reused canonical Bloomington Anarchist Black Cross based on current ABCF 2026 event evidence; added current Evansville Patchwork Central. John and Amy Rich are retained only for directly stated Co-Executive Director roles.

Greater Rockford Pantry Coalition is current first-party verified. 815 Mutual Aid Network is retained as a historical/status-uncertain anti-capitalist mutual-aid collective; a 2025 Reddit mention is insufficient to promote it to current active status. Kevin Goodrich is retained only for the directly stated GRPC president role.

Reused canonical Aetna Street Solidarity from current 2026 San Fernando Valley evidence and added current Valley Justice Coalition. Giselle Harrell and Antoinette Scully are retained only for directly stated public organizing/co-founder roles; no personal ideology inferred.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-organizational-role enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public organizational-role enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 812, 815, and 818.
